metadata.description: Superdev - tell it what you want to build, and it keeps the product map, documentation, decisions and status in step while specialist providers do the specialist work.

plugins.name: superdev
plugins.description: Describe a product in ordinary language and get a living map of goals, features, workflows, tasks, integrations, UI surfaces, decisions and evidence - plus a self-contained visual dashboard. Routes specialist work to external providers and reports their readiness truthfully.
